_doc: A 30 x 5 mm steel bar, as a ready size of the bar family (profile-bar holds the family and how to give any other size). It has no maker's sheet: every dimension is the nominal one stock is sold by, so measure the bar in hand, and its area, second moments, torsion constant and mass are worked out from its outline. The drawn outline leaves out the small radius on a drawn bar's edges.
